open_obligations.what_is_open: A terminating finite rational algorithm that gives outward brackets, all-minimizer cells, and selector and covariance witnesses for both nested exact-regret design problems.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen receipt handle specifies a search architecture but no verified uniform approximation theorem for the all-Borel Gaussian selector game. In particular, the quantitatively uniform finite-prior lower transfer, enlarged-cell selector upper transfer, and one computable diagonal schedule are absent; moreover the arbitrary frozen marginal table has no declared finite effective encoding.
open_obligations.attempted: Reduced covariance support to certified finite linear programs; checked compact positive-rate design regions, finite Gaussian priors, rectangle selectors, inverse-CDF Borel decoding, boundary pruning, and LAN transfer as the natural route. The presolve draft itself records that the constants and common diagonal schedule have not been verified end to end.
open_obligations.partial_result: For rational \(f\), \(r\), and a rational support direction, every covariance support value is a rational linear-program optimum with finite primal and dual certificates. This does not certify the nonlinear all-Borel-selector value \(G\), uniformly over covariance and design, or its optimization. The terminating outward-bracket theorem therefore does not follow from the frozen primitives.

prose_updates.tldr: One realized assignment per cluster identifies assignment-cell welfare margins but not the cross-policy coupling that determines finite-population covariance. The total calibrated Horvitz--Thompson estimator projects the compatible coupling polytope to the sharp covariance image, and the design minimizes worst compatible pairwise comparison variance. For the worked \(n_0=6\), \(m=(1,2,4)\) menu, the exact-count optimum is \(rStar=(1/3,1/3,1/3)\) with objective \(3/2\), whereas the certified nominal-label optimum has \(BpStar=(250/1383)\mathbf1_3\) and objective \(1383/500\). Thus nominal Bernoulli labels inflate the proved pairwise objective and certified cluster count by \(461/250\). The exact all-selector robust minimax-regret receipt remains open.

project_justification.fill: The project derives the sharp finite coupling polytope, proves that no single conservative covariance envelope represents it in every direction, supplies linear-program support certificates, and proves a convex exact-hit allocation theorem with necessary-and-sufficient finite KKT witnesses and an assignment-based regret guarantee. In the six-unit \(m=(1,2,4)\) consumer it gives exact rational designs, objectives, stationarity weights, and the nominal-versus-exact cluster-count factor \(461/250\).

prose_updates.related_work: AronowGreenLee2014 is the scalar two-potential-outcome sharp-variance benchmark; the slice-constant two-policy face reduces to its Fréchet--Hoeffding program. GaoGeQian2025 supplies multi-marginal optimal-transport language but neither the saturation-specific covariance projection nor an allocation choice. HarshawMiddletonSavje2026 optimizes one conservative quadratic variance bound for a fixed design and estimator; the present incomparable-covariance result shows why the full directionwise image is different, and the KKT theorem optimizes allocation over that image. LiDing2017 supplies finite-population central-limit machinery. JiangImaiMalani2023 fixes the two-stage assignment distribution, and BairdEtAl2018 studies power under maintained outcome structure. Joo2025 and GuggenbergerHuang2025 inform the still-open all-selector Gaussian receipt. EggerEtAl2022 is the worked Kenya saturation-policy consumer: on the six-unit \(m=(1,2,4)\) menu the proved pairwise-robust receipt gives exact allocations and the nominal-versus-exact objective factor \(461/250\), without claiming an exact all-selector minimax value.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The proved results cover the total calibrated Horvitz--Thompson covariance image, rational support linear programs, non-representability by one directionwise-sharp covariance envelope, robust pairwise-variance allocation, finite KKT certificates, and the empirical-best regret bound, conditional on fixed planning margins \(f\) and the common-tie local boundary. For \(n_0=6\), \(m=(1,2,4)\), the exact pairwise receipt is fully rational: exact-count objective \(3/2\), nominal objective \(1383/500\), and cluster-count ratio \(461/250\). The odd \(15\)-cell slices force \(\Xi_{kk}\ge1/900\). The exact robust all-Borel-selector design and a terminating all-minimizer receipt remain open; no total numerical equality oracle is claimed.

statement_notes.consumer: For the Kenya saturation-design consumer on the \(m=(1,2,4)\) menu, the theorem certifies \(rStar=(1/3,1/3,1/3)\) and \(pStar=(1024/4149,775/2766,3925/8298)\) by exact active-pair stationarity, with pairwise objectives \(3/2\) and \(1383/500\).
